sloka: मैथिलीं सान्त्वयस्वैनामनुरक्तां तपस्विनीम् ।शत्रुघ्नं च महात्मानं मातऽः सर्वाः परन्तप ।। ६.१२३.२० ।।
transliteration: maithilīṁ sāntvayasvaināmanuraktāṁ tapasvinīm ।śatrughnaṁ ca mahātmānaṁ māta'ḥ sarvāḥ parantapa ।। 6.123.20 ।।

translations.english: "Subduer of enemies! See your brothers, great souls Bharata and Satrughna devoted to you who are in grief due to your separation, see your mothers. Get consecrated. People will rejoice.
